comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for food trucks?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card reader takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry the fees Stripe charges: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel whenever you want; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing places?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really meet. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay on collection at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported right now.
